query:
-- Senate status breakdown
SELECT 'Senate' as chamber, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM senate_races GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
-- House status breakdown  
SELECT 'House' as chamber, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM house_races GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
-- Governor status breakdown
SELECT 'Governor' as chamber, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM governor_races GROUP BY status
ORDER BY chamber, status;

-- General races with both candidates filled
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senate_races WHERE status='General' AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL) as senate_full_matchups,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senate_races WHERE status='General') as senate_general_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house_races WHERE status='General' AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL) as house_full_matchups,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house_races WHERE status='General') as house_general_total;
